name: Nine Lives
description: Nine Lives, authored entirely from the existing atoms and expression AST.

queue-neighbors.name: queue-neighbors
queue-neighbors.description: Read four authored adjacency entries in source discovery order.

claim-component.name: claim-component
claim-component.description: Award a paying component and claim only its participating Wilds.

connected-component.name: connected-component
connected-component.description: Bounded breadth-first traversal and an authored paytable lookup.

component-scan-step.name: component-scan-step
component-scan-step.description: Visit each real symbol cell once within a symbol sweep.

candidate-components.name: candidate-components
candidate-components.description: Visit candidate components only when their total size can reach the payout threshold.

component-edge-bound.name: component-edge-bound
component-edge-bound.description: A five-cell connected set needs degree sum at least eight when there are no Wilds.

symbol-components.name: symbol-components
symbol-components.description: Enumerate all components for one symbol before considering the next symbol.

symbol-scan-step.name: symbol-scan-step
symbol-scan-step.description: Column-major first-occurrence symbol order; Wilds are not seeds.

vanish-paying-types.name: vanish-paying-types
vanish-paying-types.description: Vanish winning components and every other cell of a paying symbol type; retain unrelated Wilds.

evaluate-ordered-components.name: evaluate-ordered-components
evaluate-ordered-components.description: Preserve ordered breadth-first positions for detailed traces.

expand-frontier.name: expand-frontier
expand-frontier.description: Expand an authored four-neighbor frontier using generic finite-set operations.

claim-mask-component.name: claim-mask-component
claim-mask-component.description: Claim participating Wilds after awarding; vanish every cell of the paying symbol type.

mask-component.name: mask-component
mask-component.description: Discover one component with two initial frontier steps and at most twenty-eight further expansions.

narrow-mask-seeds.name: narrow-mask-seeds
narrow-mask-seeds.description: Use a necessary five-cell condition before untraced component traversal.

visit-mask-components.name: visit-mask-components
visit-mask-components.description: Visit every candidate component and stop when a paying size is impossible.

mask-candidates.name: mask-candidates
mask-candidates.description: Skip small paths and visit remaining components in column-major order.

mask-symbol.name: mask-symbol
mask-symbol.description: Sweep all components of one symbol before another symbol can claim Wilds.

all-symbol-mask-seeds.name: all-symbol-mask-seeds
all-symbol-mask-seeds.description: Select only components of five cells or more on a Wild-free board, excluding small stars and isolated squares.

visit-mask-components-without-wilds.name: visit-mask-components-without-wilds
visit-mask-components-without-wilds.description: The seed proof guarantees a paying size; stop when all candidate components have been visited.

mask-symbol-without-wilds.name: mask-symbol-without-wilds
mask-symbol-without-wilds.description: Sweep only symbol types selected by the board-wide seed bound.

scan-mask-without-wilds.name: scan-mask-without-wilds
scan-mask-without-wilds.description: Pay disjoint symbol components after one board-wide seed calculation.

scan-mask-with-wilds.name: scan-mask-with-wilds
scan-mask-with-wilds.description: Retain first-occurrence order and exclusive Wild claims.

evaluate-mask-components.name: evaluate-mask-components
evaluate-mask-components.description: Evaluate untraced rounds with immutable integer sets instead of temporary traversal arrays.

evaluate-components.name: evaluate-components
evaluate-components.description: Choose authored ordered traces or finite-set traversal with identical payouts and vanished cells.

refill-row-0.name: refill-row-0
refill-row-0.description: Draw one replacement into an authored column slot.

refill-row-1.description: Draw one replacement into an authored column slot.

refill-row-3.description: Draw one replacement into an authored column slot.

refill-row-4.name: refill-row-4
refill-row-4.description: Draw one replacement into an authored column slot.

gravity-column.name: gravity-column
gravity-column.description: Use the authored 32-entry stable-row table and draw only vacancies, bottom to top.

restore-row-major.name: restore-row-major
restore-row-major.description: Transpose staged column values into a row-major board with one existing map.

compact-and-refill.name: compact-and-refill
compact-and-refill.description: Stage stable columns in original RNG order, then build the board once.

cascade-step.name: cascade-step
cascade-step.description: Sequential capped award, stable refill and the next component evaluation.

cascades.name: cascades
cascades.description: At most thirty winning steps; the final step still refills and evaluates.

collect-coins.name: collect-coins
collect-coins.description: Collect initial coin prizes once at the carried multiplier, then turn coins into Wilds for this spin.

base-spin.name: base-spin
base-spin.description: Original paid-spin symbols and scatter count on the initial board.

free-spin.name: free-spin
free-spin.description: Original free-spin symbols, prize draws, collector and carried cascade multiplier.

bonus.name: bonus
bonus.description: Nine lives with no retrigger, carried multiplier and round cap termination.

paid-round.name: paid-round
paid-round.description: Resolve all base cascades before testing initial scatters and the cap.

round-entry.name: round-entry
round-entry.description: Choose purchased or paid entry from an authored state flag.
